description:
This prospectus is being issued to solicit applications for a concession campground special use permit. A permit to provide high-quality public service in the operation and maintenance of Government-owned recreation facilities located in the Rose Canyon Complex on the Santa Catalina Ranger District of the Coronado National Forest. 

The offering includes two campgrounds, two group sites, two group picnic sites, a day use fishing site and an amphitheater. The average three year gross revenue for this offering was $458,196.78.
